label: Catholic Church, Codex Iuris Canonici… supports In the Catholic practice, whatever an…
note: Can. 749 §2 makes bishops in an ecumenical council teachers and judges of faith for the universal Church when they declare a doctrine to be held definitively. This bears on the bridge: the practice's own law gives conciliar declarations normative standing. It does not show that every canon of Dei Filius is such a declaration (§3: nothing counts as infallibly defined unless that is manifest), nor that normative standing is endorsement 'by the practice's own standards' in the grammatical sense of DEF-PRACTICE-OWN-STANDARD.
